name: QM7-X (QM7b) Dataset
description: A quantum-chemistry dataset of small organic molecules with up to seven heavy atoms, including QM7b properties and computed electronic-structure quantities. This record is loader-only and does not distribute dataset files.
citation: Montavon, G., Hansen, K., Janosh, S., et al. (2013). Machine learning of molecular electronic properties in chemical compound space. New Journal of Physics, 15, 095003. https://doi.org/10.1088/1367-2630/15/9/095003
